title: NEB Class 11 English — Writing — 2023
subject: english
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: Draft a notice for your school notice board announcing a one-day 'Free Health Camp' to be held in the school premises. Include all the necessary details.
questions.solution:
**Model notice:**

```
                    [SCHOOL NAME] HIGHER SECONDARY SCHOOL
                                 Kathmandu
                              NOTICE

Date: 5 Magh 2080            Ref. No.: 14/080
Subject: Free Health Camp on 8 Magh 2080

Notice:
As you may be aware, a one-day 'Free Health Camp' will be organised
in the school premises on Saturday, 8 Magh 2080, from 8:00 a.m. to
2:00 p.m.

All students, teaching and non-teaching staff, and parents of students
may avail themselves of the following free services:
  - General health check-up (height, weight, blood pressure)
  - Eye testing and free reading glasses for school children
  - Free medicine at concessional rates

Interested persons must register their names with the Health
Coordinator in the school office before Thursday, 7 Magh 2080.
All participants should bring their health cards.

                                    Suresh Kumar Shrestva
                                    Coordinator
```

**Checklist used:** who (students, staff, parents), what (health camp with three services), when (8 Magh 2080, 8 a.m.-2 p.m.), where (school premises), how (register by 7 Magh, bring health card), plus date, reference number and signature of the writer.
questions.knowledgeNote: A good notice answers who, what, when, where and how, and ends with the date and signature of the person issuing it.
